paragraphs: Rabbi Abbahu. Rav Adda and Rava bar Chanan came to him in chapter Makom Shenahagu (I did not find it). This is not the familiar Rabbi Abbahu, Rabbi Yochanan’s student, for this one was in Babylonia (Yuchasin, in Rabbi Yishmael the wise man’s name). Perhaps this is the one who objected to Rav Ashi (see above, Rabbi Abbahu).
